# IPinfo Lite test fixture

`ipinfo-lite-sample.mmdb` is the 3,154-byte official sample downloaded on 2026-10-15 from https://ipinfo.io/data/sample/ipinfo_lite.mmdb.

Data source: [IPinfo](https://ipinfo.io/), [Lite data documentation and licensing](https://ipinfo.io/developers/ipinfo-lite-database). Data is licensed under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).

The fixture only tests MMDB decoding, hash validation and sample exclusion. It is never copied to public assets or presented as full data coverage. The import script rejects sample databases.
